**Subject:** Tenancy Architecture Decision for Next-Quarter Onboarding  

Team,

As we prepare for our next wave of customer onboarding, I have finalized the tenancy architecture for our B2B product. After evaluating our options, we will be moving forward with a **Schema-per-Tenant** approach. 

This architecture places each customer’s data into its own dedicated PostgreSQL schema. While it requires us to build out more robust migration and provisioning automation, it provides the strongest data isolation, clearer architectural boundaries, and makes tenant-specific restores or deletions significantly safer and easier to execute.

To address the operational constraints we face—specifically the 64-schema limit per cluster on our current managed PostgreSQL plan—we will distribute (shard) our 180 launch workspaces across multiple database clusters using our existing infrastructure footprint. We will build the necessary routing logic into our provisioning automation to manage this seamlessly.

With this decision locked in, we will update the next-quarter build plan to include the development of the multi-schema migrations, provisioning automation, and cluster-sharding logic required to support this model. 

Please let me know if you have any questions. 

Best regards,  
[Your Name]
